claim_scope_review.checked: Batch-local case-insensitive id and out-of-order correlation; envelope 200 not per-item success; dependent failure; service-specific size.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: No durable lookup, idempotency or generic per-item cancel inferred. Example GET successes do not prove independent arbitrary-write commit.

claim_scope_review.checked: Per-request throttling, Retry-After minimum delay, longest delay for a regrouped batch, repeated 429, SDK/batch distinctions.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: No scheduled success or universal per-HTTP-send user confirmation inferred.

claim_scope_review.checked: Single dependency and specified patterns; externalConnection can be created despite a 503 response.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Endpoint-specific counterexample to HTTP error implies nonapplication, not a classification of all 503 responses or arbitrary DAG support.

claim_scope_review.checked: Synchronous batch create atomic; asynchronous atomic/partial modes; original request index correlation; transient server retry and operation outcome separation.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Original index mapping is valid; arrival-order guessing is not. AIP Create guidance is not every batch API.

claim_scope_review.checked: BatchWriteItem non-atomic as a batch; UnprocessedItems can coexist with HTTP 200; returned subset can be resubmitted.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Complement reasoning is conditional on a complete valid response; lost response is not an empty map. Not a conditional-update adapter.

claim_scope_review.checked: All-or-nothing transaction; request-token idempotency window; ordered CancellationReasons and None diagnostics.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: No-error diagnostic within rejected transaction is not an individual commit. That conclusion combines two direct rules; fixture does not execute an atomic branch.

claim_scope_review.checked: request_id idempotency role and API-defined lifetime; resource id is distinct; stale success responses can differ.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Fixture attempt-ID rotation is not instructions to rotate a logical idempotency key; B-IU-002 safe same-key replay exception remains.

claim_scope_review.checked: Write HTTP 500 may have applied; response Request ID helps diagnostics; high-level and low-level SDK retry differences.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: No generic operation lookup/cancel or uniform SDK behavior inferred.

claim_scope_review.checked: Cancellation request is asynchronous and best effort; original operation may complete; done and successful response are distinct.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Does not establish a cancel endpoint for every batch vendor. Fixture lookup/cancel remain declared assumptions.

claim_scope_review.checked: Compensation covers completed effects and may fail; business-specific and not necessarily restoring original state.
claim_scope_review.scope_boundary: Blocked/unexecuted dependent work is not itself compensation; no implemented compensation claimed.
